goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/appservices.json (50 pages; nav: Overview, Activity log, Access control (IAM), Tags, Diagnose and solve problems, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Events (preview), Resource visualizer, Deployment, Settings, App Service plan, Development Tools, API, Monitoring)
Backend: ARM Microsoft.Web sites + core (test_azure_app_core.py): web apps, plans, configuration, deployment slots as modeled
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/appservices.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.appservices.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape
note:
DEPTH PASS (the base console is merged). Goal: turn this service's sub-sections and config sections into REAL backend integrations. For EACH capability entry listed in `depth_targets` decide:
  BUILD — Vyomi can model it in the shared core (state + native API semantics): implement it in core/<svc>_core.py (and the offline route if offline lacks it), add conformance checks in tests/conformance/, raise the entry's level in core/capabilities/<cloud>/<svc>.json (not_simulated→limited/full, config_only→limited/full where now ENFORCED, limited→full where a limitation is removed), wire the console section to it with a UI↔native-API round trip in consoles/tests/smoke-<cloud>.mjs and a "live" fixture for any list/detail page.
  KEEP HONEST — only if it needs something a local simulator cannot run (a separate product, real hardware/network, billing, third-party identity): leave it NotSimulated and put the concrete reason in the entry's `limitations`.
Prefer behaviour that is ENFORCED (e.g. lifecycle rules actually expire objects, a DLQ really receives, a policy really denies) over config that is only stored. Real coverage must go UP; nothing may regress: fidelity ≥ 90%, every capability claim true on nano AND offline, smokes green. Do not edit consoles/honest-allowlist.json or .github/.
House rules: keep consoles/src/<cloud>/kit/Capability.jsx as on base (add JSON imports only), list the service ONCE in registry.js, register any NEW core in wasm/build_cores.py + wasm/nano-boot.js (own line, never inside a // comment) + core/nano_registry.py + core/nano_persist.py (tests/conformance/test_nano_core_manifest.py), unique variable names in the smoke files, 'Vyomi' as plain text, re-vendor with python3 wasm/build_cores.py, rebuild bundles, COMMIT your source.

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM)
limitations: Role assignments/definitions scoped to a single Web App, deny assignments and classic administrators are not modelled.

depth_targets.title: Deployment Center (CI/CD source, FTPS credentials)
limitations: No source-control integration, build pipeline or FTPS deployment credentials.

depth_targets.title: Monitoring (Alerts, Metrics, Logs, Advisor recommendations, Health check, Diagnostic settings, Log stream, Process explorer)
limitations: No metrics pipeline, alert evaluation, Log Analytics export or live log/process streaming for Web Apps.

depth_targets.title: Development Tools (Clone App, Console, Advanced Tools, App Service Editor, Extensions)
limitations: No Kudu/SCM console, in-browser editor or site extension gallery.

depth_targets.title: API (API Management link, API definition, CORS)
limitations: No API Management linkage, OpenAPI definition import or CORS rule enforcement.

depth_targets.title: Authentication, Identity, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Backups, Certificates, Networking, WebJobs, Service Connector
limitations: Auth providers, managed identity, App Insights linkage, Defender, backups/restore, TLS certificates, VNet integration, WebJobs and Service Connector are not modelled.

depth_targets.title: Scale up/out, Change App Service plan, Quotas
limitations: Plan SKU is stored but changing it does not resize or move the app, and quota usage is not tracked.

depth_targets.title: Automation (Tasks, Export template)
limitations: No Automation Tasks or ARM/Bicep/Terraform template export for the Web App.

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Events (preview), Resource visualizer, Resource health, New support request
limitations: No diagnostics engine, Event Grid wiring, resource visualizer, resource-health telemetry or support-ticket flow.
